verses.text: A song for going up to worship. Of David. LORD, my heart is not proud, and my eyes do not look down on others. I do not concern myself with great matters or things too wonderful for me.
Instead, I have calmed and quieted myself, like a young child who is content with his mother. Like a contented child, I am at peace inside.
Israel, put your hope in the LORD, now and forever.
